summary: Master AI in urban planning, digital twins, and predictive maintenance. Transform spatial data into resilient smart city infrastructure. Enroll today.
lede: AI in urban planning and infrastructure development helps professionals turn fragmented spatial, infrastructure, and sensor data into informed strategies for designing, monitoring, and improving urban environments. This course explores machine learning, AI-enhanced GIS, digital twins, BIM, IoT networks, and computer vision for spatial optimization, traffic prediction, environmental modeling, and asset lifecycle management. Through practical exercises, you will apply predictive maintenance, generative zoning design, infrastructure scenario simulation, and real-time resource allocation techniques. You will also learn how to integrate AI into existing workflows while addressing budget limitations, legacy systems, data privacy compliance, stakeholder needs, and sustainability targets.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for professionals responsible for designing, managing, and optimizing urban environments and public assets. It bridges the gap between traditional infrastructure management and modern data science applications.
modules: AI and Smart City Ecosystem Foundations
AI in Transportation and Urban Mobility
Digital Twins and Climate Resilience Modeling
Data Governance, Ethics, and Public Policy
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of urban planning, GIS, civil engineering, or infrastructure project management. No advanced coding or programming experience is required, as the course focuses on the operational application of AI tools rather than software engineering. Participants must bring a laptop capable of accessing cloud-based spatial analysis platforms and simulated datasets.
